# Zebra devices

The Zebra device families that run product UI. [05-sizes-devices.md](05-sizes-devices.md) says how to design for each form factor.

A "?" is a figure nobody has filled in yet. "Checked" says whether the row was checked against Zebra's specification sheet.

| Family | Class | Display | Resolution | Inputs | Gloved use | Checked |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC53 / TC58 | handheld | 6 in | 1080 x 2160 | touch, scanner, hardware keys | yes | yes |
| TC73 / TC78 | handheld | 6 in | ? | touch, scanner, hardware keys | yes | no |
| TC22 / TC27 | handheld | ? | ? | touch, scanner, hardware keys | yes | no |
| EC50 / EC55 | handheld | ? | ? | touch, scanner | no | no |
| MC3400 | keypad handheld | 4 in | 800 x 480 | touch, keypad, scanner | yes | yes |
| MC9400 | keypad handheld | 4.3 in | ? | touch, keypad, scanner | yes | no |
| WS50 | wearable | 2 in | ? | touch, scanner | yes | no |
| ET40 / ET45 (8 in) | tablet | 8 in | 1280 x 800 | touch, scanner | no | yes |
| ET40 / ET45 (10 in) | tablet | 10 in | 1920 x 1200 | touch, scanner | no | yes |
| ET60 / ET65 | tablet | ? | ? | touch, scanner | yes | no |
| VC8300 | vehicle mount | ? | ? | touch, keyboard, scanner | yes | no |
| CC600 / CC6000 | kiosk | ? | ? | touch, scanner | no | no |

To add a device, add a row. Use a form factor from [05-sizes-devices.md](05-sizes-devices.md), or add it there first.
